claim: Milestone 2A frozen training recipe: Experiment C (conventional Adam, paper-described) hyper-parameters on the new M2 group-disjoint split; V1 ordinary FP32 and V3 PGD adversarial training run through one loop. Not an exact reproduction of Table 4. Pilot results are non-scientific development checks (1 seed, 2 epochs, small subsets, validation data only) and carry no accuracy or robustness conclusion.

source_experiment.note: Values below are copied from Experiment C. The only deliberate difference is the number of optimizer updates (the M2 training partition has a different row count).

sequence.construction: repeat scaled row 50 times (synthetic, not chronological traffic); training-only Gaussian noise std 0.01 added after repetition, independent per position, fresh each batch and epoch; evaluation noise-free

training.checkpoint_rule: final epoch only; no validation or test based selection
training.rng_policy: global seed once before model construction (paper_described_adam.seed_everything); shuffle, noise and attack streams from local generators derived with paper_described_adam.derived_seed
training.determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms is not enabled (as in Experiment C); run-to-run bit-exactness is not claimed

adversarial.retention: attacks.attack strongest-candidate rule over {FGSM candidate, random start, each iterate}
adversarial.feasible_set: lower = max(x - eps, min(0, x)), upper = min(x + eps, max(1, x)) (protocol E2)
adversarial.noise_policy: the same noise tensor is added to the clean and the adversarial sequence of a step; the attack sees the noise-free sequence
adversarial.initialisation: fresh, same seed initialisation as V1
